katie: Heads-up from today
We observed duplicate state changes during heavy onboarding tests. Pattern: 429 -> token refresh -> multiple SDK retries align. No Idempotency header in sampleapp by default.
marc: Do we know which SDK defaults caused alignment?
katie: Node and Go. Node used full-jitter with low cap, Go used fixed exp with similar medians, so retries clustered.
raj: Two short-term fixes: (1) unify a named backoff profile across SDKs with decorrelated jitter and modest cap, (2) educate sampleapp to emit an Idempotency-Key by default (opt-out).
marc: Suggest profile: "guarded-2026" attempts=6 base=120ms cap=2000ms algorithm=decorrelated-jitter refresh_guard=enabled. Also add env RW_RETRY_PROFILE to toggle.
katie: For sampleapp, generate Idempotency-Key per flow (uuid4) and keep until completion; toggle via SAMPLEAPP_IDEMPOTENCY=on/off.
raj: Implementation note: add a lightweight refresh-guard where retries seeing auth_refresh_in_progress wait rand(0, min(backoff,300ms)) before firing to avoid thundering.
marc: Tests: integration with short-lived auth TTL (<=1s) under parallel load, assert zero duplicate side-effects. Add unit fuzzing to ensure backoff intervals aren't identical.
bot-ci: CI:opened issues for sdk parity and sampleapp patch (auto).
katie: I'll own docs + sampleapp change. Marc take node/go SDK parity. Raj take tests + telemetry. Let's ship opt-in this cycle and flip default after a canary. Thanks all :thumbsup:
